Name: Kubelet API (TCP)
Description: Kubelet API, reached by the control plane over the tailnet. Does not need to be exposed to the internet.

Name: Flannel VXLAN (UDP)
Description: Flannel VXLAN overlay between nodes. Carried inside the tailnet when the Tailscale VPN integration is active.

Name: Tailscale (UDP)
Description: Tailscale direct-connection port. If blocked, Tailscale falls back to DERP relays.
